{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA rows: revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check how many such rows exist
num_qa_rows = len(qa_rows)

# Check their status
qa_status_counts = qa_rows['status'].value_counts()

# Print the number of QA rows and their status
num_qa_rows, qa_status_counts"}
